header.running_head: Exercising Patience Upon the Demise of Children, Family and Friends

blocks.text: not any more). But if you exercise patience (without taking revenge), then this is definitely best for the patient ones. Be patient! Your patience is only from Allaah (only Allaah can give you the ability to exercise patience). Do not grieve over them (the Kuffaar when they refuse to accept Islaam) and do not be saddened by their plotting (against you because Allaah will see to them).

Rasulullaah ﷺ then gave instructions for the body of Hadhrat Hamzah (RA) to be turned towards the Qiblah and performed the Janaazah salaah with nine Takbeers. All the other martyrs were then brought to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Each time a martyr was brought, he was placed beside Hadhrat Hamzah (RA) and Rasulullaah ﷺ would perform the Janaazah salaah for the martyr and Hadhrat Hamzah (RA). In this manner, Rasulullaah ﷺ performed the Janaazah salaah seventy-two times for Hadhrat Hamzah (RA). Rasulullaah ﷺ then stood by the Sahabah (RA) until the martyrs were buried. After the above verse was revealed, Rasulullaah ﷺ forgave the Mushrikeen and forsook the idea of mutilation.[^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Grief upon the Demise of Hadhrat Zaid bin Haaritha (RA)

Hadhrat Usaamah bin Zaid (RA) says, "When my father (Hadhrat Zaid bin Haaritha (RA)) was martyred, I went to see Rasulullaah ﷺ. When he saw me, Rasulullaah ﷺ started weeping. When I again went to him the next day, he said, 'Even today I felt the grief I feel when I saw you yesterday.'"[^2]

Hadhrat Khaalid bin Shumayr (RA) reports that when Hadhrat Zaid bin Haaritha (RA) was martyred and Rasulullaah ﷺ went to the Sahabah (RA), Hadhrat Zaid (RA)'s daughter burst out crying in front of Rasulullaah ﷺ. When Rasulullaah ﷺ then started weeping profusely, Hadhrat Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA) asked, "What is this, O Rasulullaah ﷺ?" "This," replied Rasulullaah ﷺ, "is the longing a friend has for his friend."[^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Grief upon the Demise of Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA)

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ kissed Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA) after his demise, his eyes were flowing with tears.[^4] In another narration, Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "I actually saw Rasulullaah ﷺ's tears flowing on the cheek of Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA)."[^5] [^6]
Bazzaar and Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.6 Pg.119) has commented on the chain of narrators. Haakim (Vol.3 Pg.197) has reported a similar narration.
